title: source-identity.md still describes content-v1 as the live ordinary measurement after its producers were removed
outcome: docs/features/source-identity.md describes only the current source_id contract for new measurements and states content-v1 solely as a stored historical form that remains readable.
acceptance: docs/features/source-identity.md no longer says the host retains or produces content-v1 for ordinary measurements (for example the 'Consumer migration and authority' section and the 'Ordinary content: preserve content-v1' section); content-v1 appears only as a stored historical form that stays readable, and what ORDINARY_COMMIT_INPUT_DEFAULT=false means today is stated from the code. No production behaviour changes, and no test reads the Markdown.
